paginate_fetch_models: paginate through a list of models on Huggingface Hub using path, params, and headers
paginate_fetch_datasets: paginate through a list of datasets on Huggingface Hub with query parameters and custom headers
paginate_fetch_spaces: paginate through a list of spaces on Huggingface Hub using the Link header format
paginate_iterate_results: iterate over paginated API results yielding items from each page automatically
paginate_handle_next_page: extract the next page URL from the Link header to continue paginating through results
